svg.aria-label: How a SLOP photo is made

g.title: pipeline
g.text: How a SLOP photo is made

g.title: cluster_prepare
g.text: 1. PREPARE THE GALLERY

g.title: cluster_choose
g.text: 2. CHOOSE REAL AND PREPARE SCENES

g.title: cluster_images
g.text: 3. GENERATE AND REVIEW IMAGES

g.title: cluster_finish
g.text: 4. FINAL REVIEW AND APPROVAL

g.title: legend
g.text: Blue = model call · White = free work · Yellow = your decision
Paid phases show their maximum. Approval includes observation.
Calls with uncertain outcomes are never retried automatically.

g.title: real
g.text: Import REAL photos into a gallery
Keep originals and source credits

g.title: describe
g.text: Describe missing REAL photos
1 confirmed call per photo · full original
Saves English description + parameters

g.title: settings
g.text: Review parameters, rules and variation chances
Optional: rewrite parameters (1 call per REAL)
Rewrite keeps descriptions; replaces manual profile edits

g.title: coverage
g.text: Compare REAL and accepted SLOP observations
Missing observations are shown and excluded
SLOP are observed automatically at approval
Existing observations are reused

g.title: choose
g.text: Select the REAL photos to start from
Visible thumbnails · select any ready subset
One selected REAL = one new scene
Thumbnails show successful generation counts
Includes verified older jobs; each edit is not a new use

g.title: draw
g.text: The server draws compatible variations · free
Dependent values share a REAL donor
Balance against observed SLOP + earlier group draws

g.title: scene
g.text: Write the new English scenes
1 confirmed text call per selected REAL

g.title: review
g.text: Read and edit each scene · free
Check changes, dependencies and photo format

g.title: generate
g.text: Generate images from saved scene text
1 separately confirmed call per scene
REAL pixels are not sent to the generator

g.title: inspect
g.text: Inspect the full image and decide
Accept it or discard and close · free
Optional evaluation: 1 confirmed call
Optional correction: preview mask + confirm 1 call
After an edit, inspect again before deciding

g.title: copy
g.text: Accept: automatically prepare the game copy · free
Browser applies treatment + shared 4:5 WebP encoding
Start with the full photo and black bars
Missing reference: show untreated fallback

g.title: final_review
g.text: Review the ready game copy beside the full image
Adjust treatment or framing if needed · free

g.title: approve
g.text: Select checked SLOP game copies
Approve one photo or the selected group
Photos without a ready copy cannot be selected
Approved photos leave this wizard

g.title: observe
g.text: Automatically observe the full SLOP original
At most 1 model call, included in approval
Reuse saved observations · no separate confirmation

g.title: publish
g.text: Find the photo in the gallery and publish it · free
Only published photos enter the game

g.title: notes
g.text: Paid work continues on the server if the page closes.
Browser copies need an open page; missing copies resume on return.
Saved copies and your adjustments are kept. Stop cancels unsent paid work.
Acquired calls finish. Approval starts observation; other phases stay separately confirmed.
Accepting an image does not publish it.
